# SYNESIS_E157 — Error

## Description

OUTPUT and REGISTRY are the same file `path`.

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: OUTPUT and REGISTRY are the same file (`path`); nothing was written.
  The SKOS would overwrite the registry of published IRIs, or the registry the SKOS.
  Give REGISTRY its own file, for example "saida/published-iris.txt".
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **RegistryIsOutput**: `block`, `path`
